pat.title: Personal access token
pat.description: Enter a user-owned fine-grained token with the Copilot Requests account permission. Classic tokens are not supported.

model.title: Configure GitHub Copilot
model.description: Choose models, optional Home Assistant tools, and conversation instructions. Tool access is disabled by default.

data_description.prompt: Trusted conversation instructions, used literally without template expansion. AI Tasks use their own action instructions.
data_description.ai_task_model: Initially uses the conversation model, then remains independently configurable.
data_description.ai_task_timeout: Applies to AI Tasks only. Assist keeps its 60-second timeout.
data_description.enable_device_control: Allows both conversations and AI Tasks to use Assist-exposed tools. Completed actions are never automatically replayed.
data_description.enable_home_assistant_api: Requires Home Assistant 2026.11 or newer and an administrator caller. Allows access to logs, history, and configuration, and can call actions or reload integrations. Access is not limited to Assist-exposed entities.

progress.authorize:
Open [GitHub device activation]({verification_uri}) and enter this code:

**{user_code}**

Authorize the GitHub Copilot integration. This dialog will continue automatically after you authorize. Close it to cancel.

abort.account_mismatch: Sign in with the same GitHub account originally used for this integration. To change accounts, add a separate GitHub Copilot integration.
abort.account_identity_unknown: The original GitHub account could not be verified. Restore its credentials and try again, or remove and re-add this integration to explicitly choose an account.
abort.oauth_not_configured: Browser sign-in is unavailable because the project OAuth app has not been configured. Use a fine-grained personal access token.
abort.oauth_unavailable: Could not start GitHub sign-in. Check the Home Assistant connection to GitHub and try again.
abort.oauth_expired: The GitHub device code expired. Start the sign-in flow again.
abort.oauth_failed: GitHub sign-in did not complete. Start the sign-in flow again.
abort.reauth_entry_missing: The Home Assistant configuration entry could not be found.
abort.reauth_required: GitHub sign-in has expired. Reauthenticate in Home Assistant.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not validate GitHub credentials or load Copilot models. Check the token, Copilot access, and network connection.
abort.no_models: No Copilot models are available for this account.
abort.quota_exceeded: GitHub Copilot quota exceeded. Check your AI Credits usage and limits in GitHub, or contact your organization administrator.

error.invalid_pat: Use a fine-grained PAT with Copilot Requests permission. Classic PATs are not supported.
error.home_assistant_api_unavailable: Administrator tools require Home Assistant 2026.11 or newer. Turn them off or update Home Assistant.

error.home_assistant_api_unavailable: Administrator tools require Home Assistant 2026.11 or newer. Turn them off or update Home Assistant.
error.task_model_unavailable: The saved AI Task model is unavailable. An available choice is shown; select a model and save.
error.model_unavailable: The previously selected model {model} is no longer available. Choose another model and save.
error.model_unavailable_fallback: The previously selected model {model} is no longer available. Conversations are using {fallback}, which is preselected. Choose a model and save.

task_model_fallback.title: GitHub Copilot AI Task model unavailable
task_model_fallback.description: AI Task model {model} is unavailable. Text and structured-data fallback: {fallback} ({billing}). Image-analysis fallback: {vision_fallback} ({vision_billing}); '-' means none is available. Each fallback stays within the known billing limit. Your conversation model is configured separately. Open GitHub Copilot > Configure to change the AI Task model.

task_model_unavailable.title: Choose a GitHub Copilot AI Task model
task_model_unavailable.description: AI Task model {model} is unavailable and no eligible same-family replacement was found. Choose an AI Task model in GitHub Copilot > Configure. The conversation model is configured separately.

model_fallback.title: GitHub Copilot model unavailable
model_fallback.description: The selected model {model} is no longer available. Conversations are temporarily using {fallback}, the closest eligible model in the same family. Billing multiplier: {billing}. When the original multiplier is known, automatic fallback cannot exceed it. To keep this model or choose another, open **Settings > Devices & services > GitHub Copilot > Configure** and save.

model_unavailable.title: GitHub Copilot model unavailable
model_unavailable.description: The selected model {model} is no longer available, and no same-family model within the known billing limit was found. GitHub Copilot conversations will fail until you choose another model in **Settings > Devices & services > GitHub Copilot > Configure**.

quota_exceeded.title: GitHub Copilot quota exceeded
quota_exceeded.description: GitHub Copilot rejected a request because its usage quota was exhausted. Check your AI Credits usage and limits in GitHub, or contact your organization administrator. Requests can resume when quota is available again. The integration does not switch models or automatically retry quota failures. This notice clears after a successful conversation or validated AI Task response.
